problem_title: Recurring Fixing/Reparing Potholes — J P Park (2019–2022)
problem_summary: 11 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in J P Park between February 2019 and July 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 46% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 34 pothole complaints.
21 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹36.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 11 of 11 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.47). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.46, complaint_volume=0.37.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='J P Park' matched to datameet243=38 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.487).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for J P Park for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 21 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
